spanish: Y vinieron los varones sobre las mujeres; todo generoso de corazón trajeron broche y zarcillo y anillo y collar, todo utensilio de oro, y todo varón que balanceó balanceo de oro a Jehová.

findings.issue: "generoso" selects the liberal sense of נדיב; the adjective also licenses willing/voluntary.
"zarcillo" specifies an earring; נֶזֶם is a ring whose place (nose or ear) the lemma leaves open.
"collar" specifies a necklace; כּוּמָז is an unidentified gold ornament.
"utensilio" leans toward a tool; כְּלִי also denotes a vessel or article.

notes: Jehová, sobre, and the cognate balanceó/balanceo stay inside the tokens.
